item.title: Nihongo Network Discord Registration (April 15, 2026)
item.description:
Complete the registration process to receive an email with the invite link to the USJETAA 日本語 ネットワーク Discord server.

This is currently free and open to the community. If you are a JET, please log into your USJETAA account (or create one if you're not already registered) before registering.

Both language learners and language coaches are in the Nihongo Network Discord. Ask questions and share resources with your community of fellow 日本語 learners.

Thank you to our sponsor:

item.title: JET Program Info Session (September 24, 2026)
item.description:
JET Program Virtual Info Session 

Are you interested in teaching in Japan or curious about the JET Program? Whether you're actively preparing your application or just starting to explore the opportunity, this 90-minute virtual info session will give you the insights you need to take the next step.

What to Expect:

  • Firsthand Experiences: Hear from a panel of JET alumni who will share their personal experiences living and working in Japan on JET.

  • Application Tips: Guidance from a JET Program Coordinator on the process and what makes a strong application.

  • Q&A Session: Ask your questions and get real-time answers.

Can’t make it? Don't worry, the session will be recorded! Register to receive the Zoom link and recording.

This event is part of our NEXT JET Program,
connecting aspiring JETs with alumni and current participants.

item.title: USJETAA Japanese Language Coaching: October 2026 (October 02, 2026)
item.description:
The goal of our Japanese Language Coaching sessions is to help learners improve their skills with practical tips and strategies. Whether you're looking to enhance your reading, speaking, or comprehension, these sessions are designed for advanced beginners and intermediate learners.

Each session, we'll focus on a different topic, providing expert guidance and answering any questions you have. Our coaches, with over 40 years of combined experience, understand the unique challenges of mastering Japanese as a non-native speaker and can provide the support you need to continue making progress. 一緒にがんばろう！

The Zoom link will be sent upon completing your registration.

item.title: PNWJETAA Transitions 2026- Featuring Career Compass (October 03, 2026)
item.description:
2026 TRANSITIONS
featuring
Career Compass: Navigating Towards Japan

Career Compass 10am-2pm |  Expo 2pm-4pm

  • 9:45am Doors open
  • Career Compass Workshop
  • Industry & Market Update
  • Panel Discussion
  • Networking Reception (light food & beverages provided)
  • Expo (and brief JET Info Session)
  • 4pm: Event Concludes

For event details, please visit the 2026 Transitions event webpage. 
Questions? Reach out to transitions@pnwjetaa.org

    Space is limited, so we encourage you to register early! We look forward to welcoming you and supporting this opportunity to consider other Japan-facing career pathways and expand your local network.

item.title: Aspiring JETs: Office Hours (October 06, 2026)
item.description:
Aspiring JETs: Office Hours

These are free, virtual office hours designed to be informal and welcoming. This is a one-hour time block for you to drop in to ask any questions or seek advice on the JET Program experience or the application itself. We typically have a few JET alumni and at least one JET Program Coordinator with us to answer your questions. There is no formal presentation, etc. and we do not record these sessions.

You are welcome to register for additional Office Hour sessions if you still have remaining questions or new one that pop up!

Zoom link and details sent to your inbox upon completing registration. 

This series is part of our NEXT JET Program,
connecting aspiring JETs with alumni and current participants.

item.title: Career Coaching: Career Clarity Reset (October 07, 2026)
item.description:
Career Clarity Reset: Start Where You Are

This is a 3-month workshop series where you will become part of a small JET-alum cohort. You will work with each other and Emily to make progress on identifying where you want to go next. This workshop series will be especially helpful for recently returned JETs, although Emily has extensive experience working with JETs in all phases of their career.

You will be guided through self-exploration through the workshops and have space for one-on-one conversations with Emily and your fellow JET alums during the touchpoints. Workshops are 90 minutes long and touchpoints are 60 minutes. In total, you'll have 6 sessions with Emily and fellow JETs to help you gain better clarity of what you want next and how to get there.

This program is heavily subsidized through a grant from the Japan-United States Friendship Commission. 

Schedule:
*all sessions are scheduled on Wednesday evenings

  1. Oct. 7, 8-9pm ET
  2. Oct. 14, 8-9:30pm ET
  3. Nov. 4, 8-9:30pm ET
  4. Nov. 18, 8-9pm ET
  5. Dec. 2, 8-9:30pm ET
  6. Dec. 16, 8-9pm ET

Zoom link will be provided in the confirmation email.

item.title: USJETAA Japanese Reading Group: October 2026 (October 09, 2026)
item.description:
The goal of the USJETAA Japanese Reading Group is to help advanced beginner and intermediate level students improve their reading skills. Each month, we explore a short reading and discuss its literary and cultural significance. Participants should attempt to do the reading on their own and come to the meeting with any questions. We will spend the meeting each month reading the assignment sentence by sentence to understand how the Japanese is working.

Registration is free, but we always appreciate donations to support these types of programs. Zoom link will be sent upon completing registration.

Post questions, discuss the reading, etc. in our
USJETAA Japanese Reading Group Facebook Group.

In October, we will read the second part of the essay ふきのとう (Fukinotou, the edible flower of the giant butterbur plant) by French literature scholar and essayist Naoko Kasama from her award winning collection 山影の町から (From the Town in the Shadow of the Mountain).Click here for the reading.

Thank you to our Reading Group Sponsor

item.title: TUJ Info Session (November 13, 2026)
item.description:
Join this info session with Temple University Japan (located in Tokyo) to learn about their Masters in Management program, scholarships offered to JETs and alumni, and how the application process works. With several JET alumni on staff at TUJ and in their academic programs, we anticipate some JET alum speakers on this virtual session. This information session is free and open to JETs and alumni. 

Details and Zoom link will be sent to your inbox upon registering.
